signals.title: Sawdust
signals.summary: A woodworking design environment models stock, tools, cuts, kerf, joinery, assembly, and waste, then can produce manufacturable plans and files rather than only a rendered CAD-like artifact.
signals.creator: Taylor Finley
signals.what_was_created: A woodcraft design and simulation tool that can export STEP, 3D-print files, material lists, cut plans, build guides, and AR dimensions.
signals.what_ai_changed: AI lowers the cost of translating a maker's intent into material-aware design, cut-list, and manufacturing procedure.
signals.human_behavior_change: A maker can operate through woodworking concepts instead of first learning generic CAD abstractions.
signals.transferable_idea: Model domain primitives rather than software primitives when the goal is domain-native creation.

signals.title: Trebella
signals.summary: A music-practice product analyzes uploaded sheet music and supports practice sessions, warm-ups, and microphone-based feedback while positioning itself as complementary to teachers.
signals.creator: Trebella independent creator with music teachers
signals.what_was_created: A practice loop around scores, preparation time, performance observation, and the next attempt for classical instruments.
signals.what_ai_changed: AI could increase the frequency of individualized practice feedback; fine-grained performance feedback remains an acknowledged product blocker.
signals.human_behavior_change: Independent daily practice can be observed and structured between human lessons.
signals.transferable_idea: For practiced skills, design observation, feedback, and the next attempt before designing more course content.

signals.title: Structo
signals.summary: A writing tool makes author-created idea blocks its primary editing object, letting an LLM render rearranged structures into coherent prose and surface logical gaps.
signals.creator: Redbeard Lab
signals.what_was_created: An accessible idea-block editor that can reorganize the structure of a piece before rendering surface language.
signals.what_ai_changed: LLMs lower the cost of converting semantic structure into connected prose after each structural revision.
signals.human_behavior_change: Writers can spend more attention arranging claims, evidence, and narrative relationships than repairing every sentence transition.
signals.transferable_idea: When low-level expression is cheap, move the primary control surface to the next useful abstraction layer.

signals.title: TableForge
signals.summary: An AI Dungeon Master product combines persistent narrative and world state with deterministic D&D 5e rules, enabling real-time or asynchronous multiplayer campaigns.
signals.creator: Independent solo developer
signals.what_was_created: A persistent social D&D experience where all friends can be players while software facilitates narrative, state, and some coordination.
signals.what_ai_changed: AI and deterministic software can absorb parts of the compound Dungeon Master role at software-like marginal cost.
signals.human_behavior_change: Distributed friends can sustain a shared campaign without requiring one participant to permanently give up playing to facilitate it.
signals.transferable_idea: Look for group activities that require someone to organize, host, record, or arbitrate instead of participating.

signals.title: Total Solar Eclipse 3D Visualizer
signals.summary: Google AI presented an AI Studio-built interactive 3D visualizer for the 2026-08-12 total solar eclipse; it follows the lunar shadow and simulates local skies for a single event.
signals.creator: Google AI / Google AI Studio
signals.what_was_created: A one-event interactive visualization for an eclipse whose user demand rapidly expires after the event.
signals.what_ai_changed: AI lowers the implementation cost enough that rich interactive software can economically share an event's short lifecycle.
signals.human_behavior_change: A special event can prompt creation of a dedicated interactive experience instead of only a map, article, or generic app.
signals.transferable_idea: Some software should optimize an important moment and then complete its mission rather than pursue retention.

patterns.title: Domain-native AI Interface
patterns.summary: Users directly manipulate domain objects rather than prompts or generic software abstractions.
patterns.outlook: Strong: as model capability commoditizes, domain grammar can become the durable interface differentiation.

patterns.title: High-level Authoring / Low-level Rendering
patterns.summary: Humans control ideas, structure, and intent while models render the lower-level expression.
patterns.outlook: Strong: the pattern can spread from writing to design, video, software, and knowledge expression.

patterns.title: Human Role Bottleneck Removal
patterns.summary: AI makes a necessary group role less dependent on one participant sacrificing their own participation.
patterns.outlook: Medium-high: facilitator, coordinator, and referee roles have potential, while social quality remains the limiting factor.

patterns.title: Temporary / Event-specific Software
patterns.summary: Software can share the lifecycle of a single event rather than needing a long-lived SaaS model.
patterns.outlook: Likely to recur as a digital medium even when it does not create conventional recurring-product economics.

ideas.title: Domain Procedure as a Medium
ideas.summary: A modifiable, explainable, simulatable, executable, and recombinable domain procedure could sit between static documentation and software; record the direction without building a general platform now.
